integrity: The proof derives the generalized characteristic polynomials directly, proves the complete 2x2 optimum, and uses an exact three-node path to establish the first ordering-dependent dimension. Broad ordering effects and red/black SSOR optimality are treated as prior work. The cited journal issues appeared earlier in print at month resolution; the date field uses the earliest exact day-resolved public date verified in the inspected publisher records rather than inventing a print day.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic spectral-condition-number result for SSOR preconditioning. The two-dimensional statement is complete; the three-dimensional path proves minimality and local suboptimality of omega=1 for one ordering but does not solve the global optimal omega for every 3x3 SPD matrix or every permutation. Wall-clock performance, finite precision, and Krylov iteration counts are outside scope.
title: Three dimensions are minimal for ordering-dependent SSOR relaxation
